messages:
emily-cs: FYI customer reported a subtle change in response 'affect' after the recent model bump. they say answers feel flatter and less warm, shorter sentences. attached examples below and request id. asking for help to triage asap.

emily-cs: customer quote: "we noticed the assistant used to say things like 'happy to help!' and now it replies 'ok'. it's not wrong, just... dry. makes our product feel robotic."

emily-cs: repro info: request_id=rid_9a8b7c, model=redwood-alpha-ctl-v3, time=2025-09-24T15:22:11Z. simple chat call, system prompt unchanged.

emily-cs: examples (before / after):
```
// v2 reply
User: I can't find my invoice, can you help?
Assistant: Sorry about that — I can help track it down. Can you share the order number or the email on the account?

// v3 reply
User: I can't find my invoice, can you help?
Assistant: Please provide the order number or account email.
```

sam-eng: thanks, emily. can you paste the exact request payload? curious about decoding params (temp, top_p) and any rollout flags. also did we change any system tokens or safety layers during the v3 rollout?

emily-cs: payload (sanitized):
```json
{"model":"redwood-alpha-ctl-v3","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"I can't find my invoice, can you help?"}],"temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.95}
```

alex-ml: quick thought — that pattern (same content, terser phrasing) can come from small changes in preference weights or a different RLHF checkpoint. also possible new default prompt tokens being shorter. i can run a controlled A/B with v2 vs v3 on our evaluation prompt set. please attach a few more customer examples if available.

maria-support: saw one other ticket this week noting "less empathetic" replies from our assistant after last upgrade but they included different repro steps. ticket 2312 and 2340 may be related. both customers sought tone not correctness.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: redwood-alpha-ctl-v3 rolled to canary and majority clusters at 2025-09-24T14:58:03Z by ci-pipeline #4821.

sam-eng: good call alex. i'll pull model diffs and check whether any post-processing trimming was introduced (we recently patched whitespace/ellipsis normalization in the decode stage). if we didn't intentionally modify the preference model, we should compare token-level logprobs on customer prompts.

emily-cs: customer is asking for an ETA and whether we can revert the rollout for their tenant. can we confirm risk/impact?

alex-ml: A/B results will take ~2 hours to run locally on the eval harness. if we confirm v3 skews brevity, options: 1) revert to v2 for affected customers, 2) add a soft style steering instruction (system message) for those tenants, or 3) adjust decoding (increase temp slightly or nudge beam). i'll post results when ready.

sam-eng: also logging note — include request_id and response hash next time, that speeds lookup. emily, i'll keep this P1 until we know if it's model or infra.

emily-cs: thanks — passing to customer: "we're investigating, will update in ~2-3h with findings or mitigation." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
